name: Present interval 0 (optional)
description: Optional add-on for unlocked-fps: requests interval 0. In suyu it is equivalent to vsync at 120 Hz with the limiter active. It is incompatible with the main patch (both touch 0x2AA278C): use only for testing, applying it afterwards.
offsets: offset of the main module (= Ghidra address - 0x7100000000; = pchtxt offset with offset_shift 0x100; IPS = offset + 0x100)

patches.note: nvnWindowSetPresentInterval(win, 0): no vsync wait on console; in suyu interval 0 is interpreted as x2 speed (vsync at 120 Hz with the limiter active)
